personal_state_values_check.name: personal_state_values_check
personal_state_values_check.value:
"personal_state"."progress" >= 0
        and ("personal_state"."progress_total" is null or "personal_state"."progress_total" >= 0)
        and ("personal_state"."status" not in ('saved', 'planned') or "personal_state"."progress" = 0)

terms_controlled_values_check.name: terms_controlled_values_check
terms_controlled_values_check.value:
(
        "terms"."vocabulary" <> 'genre'
        or "terms"."name" in (
          'Action', 'Adventure', 'Comedy', 'Crime', 'Drama', 'Fantasy',
          'Historical', 'Horror', 'Mecha', 'Music', 'Mystery', 'Psychological',
          'Romance', 'Science Fiction', 'Slice of Life', 'Sports',
          'Supernatural', 'Thriller', 'War'
        )
      ) and (
        "terms"."vocabulary" <> 'tone'
        or "terms"."name" in (
          'Wholesome', 'Emotional', 'Bittersweet', 'Reflective', 'Tense',
          'Energetic', 'Dark', 'Whimsical', 'Epic', 'Atmospheric'
        )
      ) and (
        "terms"."vocabulary" <> 'audience'
        or "terms"."name" in ('Adult', 'Young Adult', 'Teen', 'General')
      )

work_relations_direction_check.name: work_relations_direction_check
work_relations_direction_check.value:
("work_relations"."relation_type" in ('alternative', 'related') and "work_relations"."is_directed" = false and "work_relations"."source_work_id" < "work_relations"."target_work_id")
        or ("work_relations"."relation_type" not in ('alternative', 'related') and "work_relations"."is_directed" = true)

work_seasons_values_check.name: work_seasons_values_check
work_seasons_values_check.value:
"work_seasons"."position" >= 0
        and ("work_seasons"."runtime_minutes" is null or "work_seasons"."runtime_minutes" >= 0)
        and ("work_seasons"."unit_count" is null or "work_seasons"."unit_count" >= 0)

work_units_values_check.name: work_units_values_check
work_units_values_check.value:
"work_units"."position" >= 0
        and ("work_units"."runtime_minutes" is null or "work_units"."runtime_minutes" >= 0)
        and ("work_units"."page_count" is null or "work_units"."page_count" >= 0)

works_metrics_check.name: works_metrics_check
works_metrics_check.value:
("works"."runtime_minutes" is null or "works"."runtime_minutes" >= 0)
        and ("works"."playtime_minutes" is null or "works"."playtime_minutes" >= 0)
        and ("works"."page_count" is null or "works"."page_count" >= 0)
        and ("works"."episode_count" is null or "works"."episode_count" >= 0)
        and ("works"."chapter_count" is null or "works"."chapter_count" >= 0)
        and ("works"."volume_count" is null or "works"."volume_count" >= 0)
        and ("works"."route_count" is null or "works"."route_count" >= 0)

works_metadata_normalized_check.name: works_metadata_normalized_check
works_metadata_normalized_check.value:
json_type("works"."metadata", '$.aliases') is null
        and json_type("works"."metadata", '$.externalLinks') is null
        and json_type("works"."metadata", '$.genres') is null
        and json_type("works"."metadata", '$.tags') is null
        and json_type("works"."metadata", '$.tone') is null
        and json_type("works"."metadata", '$.studios') is null
        and json_type("works"."metadata", '$.creator') is null
